description: Classify text sentiment (fast sub-200ms DistilBERT SST-2 positive/negative, or 3-way positive/neutral/negative with mode="detailed") and optional custom zero-shot labels. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

labels.description: Optional 2-12 comma-separated custom labels for zero-shot classification.

mode.description: Optional: fast (default DistilBERT) or detailed (3-way positive/neutral/negative).
